tournament.name: December OCC - Qualifier A
tournament.description: OCC DECEMBER SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - December 10th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline December 10th @ 1200 GMT) - (participation confirmation deadline December 9th) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season. Round of 8 Finals - December 17th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline December 15th @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
